steps.title: UI kit: bundled fonts, ui_kit.gd tokens/components, legacy helpers delegate (global restyle)
steps.instructions:
Goal: every existing call site picks up the new look through the shared helpers, with no change to any signature, test-visible member, or show_* body. Read docs/ui_style.md (the merged spec) sections 3-4 first. All numbers are in the 941x1672 design space.

0. BASELINE: before editing, take the baseline screenshots listed in verify into $SCRATCHPAD/ui/s01/before/.

1. FONTS
- mkdir game/assets/fonts.
- Copy Rubik-VF.ttf, Nunito-VF.ttf, Rubik-OFL.txt and Nunito-OFL.txt from /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/ui/fonts_dl/ if they exist. Verify sha256:
  - Rubik-VF.ttf = 1b3a7437ba2af80e465e773ed60c5036d1ba6ace492d89046dbcf18fb31e4e88
  - Nunito-VF.ttf = bb55a5ca5c2042335b3991af27c4d0705d0ef41cac6164ac737fd8f2a1e85207
- Otherwise download them with curl:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/rubik/Rubik%5Bwght%5D.ttf
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/nunito/Nunito%5Bwght%5D.ttf
  - .../ofl/rubik/OFL.txt and .../ofl/nunito/OFL.txt
- Name them Rubik-VF.ttf, Nunito-VF.ttf, OFL-Rubik.txt, OFL-Nunito.txt.
- Write 3 FontVariation resources in exactly this format (it is what Godot 4.5.1 ResourceSaver produces; 2003265652 is the 'wght' tag):
```
[gd_resource type="FontVariation" load_steps=2 format=3]

[ext_resource type="FontFile" path="res://assets/fonts/Rubik-VF.ttf" id="1"]

[resource]
base_font = ExtResource("1")
variation_opentype = {
2003265652: 900
}
```
  - display_900.tres: Rubik, 900
  - display_800.tres: Rubik, 800
  - body_800.tres: Nunito-VF.ttf, 800
- In game/project.godot add a [gui] section in alphabetical order with: theme/custom_font="res://assets/fonts/display_800.tres". Do not enable MSDF.
- Import: flock -w 1800 /tmp/raivon_godot.lock /opt/godot/Godot_v4.5.1-stable_linux.x86_64 --headless --path game --import

2. game/scripts/ui_kit.gd
- `extends RefCounted`, NO class_name.
- Everyone uses it as `const Kit := preload("res://scripts/ui_kit.gd")`.
- Static vars are allowed (Godot 4.5).

Implement:

a) Tokens
- Every colour of spec §3.2 as a const: INK, SLATE, SLATE_LIP, SLATE_WELL, SLATE_FILL, SLATE_HI, CREAM, CREAM_LIP, CREAM_WELL, CREAM_ROW, ROW_LIP, CREAM_DEEP, SKY_TOP, SKY_LOW, GRASS, BLUEPRINT, SEA_WELL, FULL, TEXT, SOFT, POS, NEG, WARN, INK_TEXT, SOFT_CREAM, MUTED_CREAM, POS_CREAM, NEG_CREAM, WARN_CREAM, RARITY dict.
- const ROLE := {go:[#5CC93B,#3A8F22], info:[#3E9BF0,#2266B8], war:[#EF4B3F,#A92A23], gold:[#FFC531,#C98A0C], lock:[#A7AFBC,#6C7482], slate:[#3A5089,#1D2843], energy:[#23C4D8,#13839A], brass:[#E6B13E,#9C6B1C], steel:[#B9C7D6,#6A7C93]}.
- static gloss(face) = face.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.38).
- SCALE := [22,24,26,28,30,32,36,40,44,46,60,64].
- RADII := [0,8,14,20,24,34].

b) Fonts
- static func font(kind) -> Font, kind in d900 / d800 / b800.
- Lazily load the three .tres and cache them.

c) Snapping
- snap_size(s): the smallest SCALE value >= s, clamped to 22..64.
- snap_radius(r): <4 -> 0; 4-16 -> 14; 17-22 -> 20; 23-28 -> 24; 29-40 -> 34; >40 -> unchanged (circles).

d) static func label(text, size, color := TEXT, bold := true) -> Label
Use THEME OVERRIDES, not LabelSettings: call sites recolour labels and _fit uses get_theme_font.
- Font:
  - bold and size >= 26 -> d900
  - bold and size < 26 -> d800
  - not bold -> b800
- font_size = snap_size(size).
- If luminance(color) >= 0.5 (light text):
  - bold: font_outline_color INK; outline_size clamp(round(sz/7),3,8); font_shadow_color INK; shadow_offset_x 0; shadow_offset_y clamp(round(sz/14),2,5); shadow_outline_size = outline.
  - not bold: outline 0; shadow INK offset_y 2.
- Dark text: outline 0, shadow alpha 0.
- mouse_filter IGNORE.

e) static func style(face, r := 20, out := 4, outline := INK, shadow := 6, lip := 0) -> StyleBoxFlat
- bg = face; all corners r; border colour INK, width out; corner_detail 10; anti_aliasing true.
- If shadow > 0: shadow_color = Color(INK, 0.35), shadow_size = 1, shadow_offset = Vector2(0, shadow). (Verified by a Godot 4.5.1 render: size 1 plus an offset gives a hard shadow; size 0 draws nothing.)
- set_meta("kit_lip", lip) and set_meta("kit_face", face).

f) static func legacy_style(bg, radius, border, bw) -> StyleBoxFlat (backs the old _style)
Face:
- alpha < 0.05: keep a transparent face with the given border (the coach ring relies on this).
- luminance < 0.2 (all the navy PANEL / PANEL_2 / 0.1,0.15,0.25 variants): SLATE, opaque, lip 6.
- luminance > 0.75 and warm (parchment): CREAM, lip 0.
- otherwise: the face of role_of(bg), lip = that role's lip, i.e. buttons styled through _style.
Border and shadow:
- Border width: bw == 0 -> 0; bw <= 2 -> 3; else 4. Colour INK.
- Radius: snap_radius(radius).
- Shadow: 4 if bw > 0, else 0.
- Alpha is always forced to 1 (no translucent panels anywhere).

g) static func role_of(c: Color) -> String
First match these legacy literals, tolerance 0.03 per channel:
- info: (0.13,0.4,0.9), (0.16,0.42,0.95), (0.16,0.35,0.75)
- go: (0.2,0.55,0.3), (0.2,0.6,0.3), (0.12,0.36,0.2), (0.2,0.4,0.25)
- war: (0.8,0.22,0.16), (0.75,0.16,0.12), (0.85,0.15,0.13), (0.9,0.2,0.15)
- gold: (0.75,0.55,0.12), (0.85,0.55,0.1), (0.8,0.6,0.1)
- info (purples): (0.45,0.3,0.75), (0.55,0.25,0.8), (0.35,0.2,0.55), (0.55,0.3,0.95)
- info (greys): (0.3,0.33,0.42), (0.3,0.35,0.45), (0.32,0.36,0.46), (0.14,0.18,0.27)
- info (browns): (0.45,0.35,0.2), (0.35,0.22,0.12)
Otherwise fall back to HSV:
- s < 0.2 -> info
- hue 0.22-0.45 -> go
- hue 0.47-0.70 -> info
- hue >= 0.94 or <= 0.03 -> war
- hue 0.04-0.17 -> gold
- else -> info

h) class KitDecor extends Control
- mouse IGNORE; set_anchors_preset(FULL_RECT).
- _draw: the lip band Rect2(out, h-out-lip, w-2*out, lip) in the lip colour, with bottom corners r-out (draw it via a cached StyleBoxFlat draw on the canvas item).
- A top highlight line 2 px at y=out+1 from x=r to w-r: SLATE_HI on slate faces, white a0.7 on cream.

i) class KitButton extends Panel
Properties: role, size_class (L/M/S/XS, auto from height: >=104 L, >=80 M, >=52 S, else XS), caption, icon, price (Array of [icon_name, text, short:bool]), enabled, hold, hold_sec := 1.2, cb, signal denied.
Geometry by class:

| Class | R | OUT | lip | shadow y | caption | fit floor | icon |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| L | 24 | 5 | 10 | 8 | 40 (2 lines 32) | 30 | 72 |
| M | 20 | 4 | 8 | 6 | 32 | 26 | 56 |
| S | 20 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 26 | 22 | 44 |
| XS | 14 | 3 | 5 | 4 | 24 | 22 | 32 |

Drawing:
- In _draw, from cached StyleBoxFlats: hard shadow (INK a0.35, offset y, hidden while pressed) -> INK body -> face inset OUT with border_width_bottom = lip in the lip colour -> gloss band (inset 8 at the sides, 12 for L; 5 at the top; height 34% of the face above the lip; radius max(4, R-OUT-6); colour gloss(face)).
- Disabled: lock face and lip, no gloss.
- Children: Label named 'cap' (Kit.label, white, bold); optional TextureRect 'ic'; optional price plate (INK a0.85 pill, height 0.5 of the face, with an icon and a NUM text per item). Lay them out as one centred row in the face above the lip, side padding 16 (L: 18), gap 10.
- Caption fitting: step down through the SCALE to the class floor. Only L may wrap to 2 lines (at '\n', or at the space nearest the middle) at 32.
Input (gui_input):
- Press: PRESS_IN tween over 70 ms QUAD/OUT (lip -> 2, face offset lip-2, scale 0.96, pivot at the centre).
- Release: PRESS_OUT over 140 ms BACK/OUT. If the release is inside, call cb when enabled; when disabled, run Kit.shake(self) and emit denied.
- Never use modulate.a for the disabled state.
- Hold mode: a white a0.75 strip grows left->right inside the face over hold_sec, cb runs on completion, and an early release cancels it.
- Keep the release-fires semantics of the existing _is_tap.

j) Factories
- button(parent, rect, role, caption, opts := {}) -> KitButton. opts: icon, price, size, cb, enabled, hold, hold_sec, filter.
- icon_button(parent, rect, icon, role := 'slate', round := false, caption := '', cb := Callable()) -> KitButton
  - icon: 74% of h for a square, 70% for a round button
  - optional caption plate: INK pill h 30, MICRO 22 white, overlapping the bottom by 14
- close_button(panel, cb): Ø76, war, vector X, centre (panel.size.x-40, 4), hit area 104.
- back_button(panel, cb): Ø76, info, chevron, centre (40, 4).
- hex_badge(parent, center, R, role, text): pointy-top hexagon; corners rounded via Geometry2D.offset_polygon(pts,-0.22R,JOIN_MITER) then +0.22R JOIN_ROUND; lip 0.14R; gloss; numeral 1.05R d900 white outlined.
- title_plate(panel, text, role := 'info', icon := '')
  - KitShape, h 84, ends pointed at 0.36h, corner radius 9 via offset_polygon(-9, MITER) then (+9, ROUND)
  - layers: shadow +8 -> INK -> face inset 5 with lip 9 -> gloss
  - width = clamp(text_w + 108 (+64 with an icon), 320, panel.size.x - 200), centred on the panel's top edge (y = -42)
  - text TITLE 46 white outlined, fit floor 32
  - icon 92 at the left point
- dot(parent, n := -1, role := 'war')
  - Ø40 with a number (MICRO 22, '99+') or Ø26 without
  - INK ring 3 -> white ring 4 -> role face
  - centred on the parent's top-right corner, offset (-4, +6)
- bar(parent, rect, frac, role, label := '', on_paper := false): see spec §4.7.
- chip(parent, pos, icon, text, kind := 'status'): status / owner / stat / timer, see spec §4.8.
- price(parent, pos, items, h := 34, on := 'dark').
- star(parent, center, R, full): a 5-point polygon, INK 4. Full = gold face + gloss; empty = CREAM_DEEP relief.
- class KitShape extends Control draws polygons plus vector chrome: x, check, chevron_left, chevron_right, plus, minus, arrow_up, arrow_right, swap (two arrows), star, star_empty. The stroke is a white 9 px line over an 18 px INK line, with circles at the ends, scaled to the box.

k) static func icon_tex(name) -> Texture2D
- Look in res://assets/ui/icons/<name>.png, then res://assets/ui/<name>.png, then ICON_FALLBACK[name].
- ICON_FALLBACK maps: swords->target, shield->fort, dove->hands, treaty->orders, seal->lock, handshake->hands, globe->scales, horn->target, gift->crate, coins->coin, lightning->hourglass, barrel->oil, calendar->hourglass, charter->book, chest_wood->crate, chest_royal->crown, chest_cards->cards, medal_bronze/medal_silver/medal_gold->medal, shard->frame, blueprint->flask, xp->medal, mason->builder, white_flag->orders, pencil->gear, sound_on/sound_off->gear, dice->cards, eye_off->lock.
- Return null if none of them exists.

l) const PICTO and static func split_icons(text) -> Array
- Returns pieces: {t:text}, {i:icon_name} or {v:chrome}.
- PICTO icon mappings: 💎 raivite, 🔒 lock, 🎬 ad, ⚔ swords, 🕊 dove, 💰 coins, ⚒ hammer, 🎁 gift, 📜 treaty, 🔬 flask, ⏱ hourglass, ⛳ orders, ⇢ orders, ⚡ lightning, ⏩ lightning, 🌍 globe, 🔊 sound_on, 🔇 sound_off, 🐴 cart, 🎲 dice, 🏰 castle_icon, 🎖 medal, 📅 calendar, 🔏 seal, ✎ pencil.
- PICTO chrome mappings: ⬆ v:arrow_up, ⇄ v:swap, ➕ v:plus, ★ v:star, ⭐ v:star, ☆ v:star_empty, ✓ v:check, ✕ v:x, ↩ v:chevron_left, ‹ v:chevron_left, › v:chevron_right.
- Any other char in U+1F000-1FAFF, U+2600-27BF, U+2190-21FF, U+2B00-2BFF or U+25A0-25FF, and U+FE0F, is dropped. Trim the spaces left behind.

m) Formatters
- fmt_num(n), RU (L.lang()=='ru'):
  - exact below 10 000, grouped with U+00A0 (NOT U+202F: Rubik lacks it)
  - 10 000-99 999 -> '12,4K'
  - 100 000-999 999 -> '124K'
  - >= 1e6 -> '1,2M'
  - negatives use U+2212
- fmt_num(n), EN: ',' grouping, '.' decimal.
- fmt_exact(n): always exact.
- fmt_dec(x, d := 1): locale decimal separator.
- fmt_time(sec):
  - < 3600: 'm:ss'
  - < 86400: L.t('time.hm') % [h, m]
  - >= 86400: L.t('time.dh') % [d, h]
  - < 60: keep 'time.s'

n) Motion
- press_in, press_out, pop_in(node) (scale 0.86->1 over 240 ms BACK/OUT, pivot at the centre).
- close_fx(node): 120 ms scale 0.94 + a0, then queue_free. Free immediately when DisplayServer.get_name()=='headless'.
- shake(node): x ±8, 3 cycles, 240 ms.
- badge_pop, breathe, count_up(label, from, to, ms := 450).
- static var reduce_motion := false: all durations become 0 and there is no breathing.

o) static func paperize(box: Control) (contrast shim for not-yet-migrated modals)
- Return if box.has_meta('kit_native').
- Walk the descendants. For each Label whose nearest Panel ancestor is the box itself, or a Panel with meta 'well', and is not inside a KitButton, recolour by its font_color:
  - near-white (lum > 0.85) -> INK_TEXT
  - gold/yellow (r>0.85, g>0.6, b<0.6) -> WARN_CREAM
  - blue-grey MUTED-like (sat<0.25, 0.55<=lum<=0.85) -> MUTED_CREAM
  - green -> POS_CREAM
  - red -> NEG_CREAM
  - then outline_size 0 and shadow alpha 0
- For each non-KitButton Panel whose stylebox face luminance < 0.3: replace the stylebox with a well (CREAM_WELL, R 20, no border, no shadow) and set meta 'well'.

p) Safe area
- static func vb(node) -> float: canvas visible bottom minus the safe-area bottom, using get_display_safe_area scaled by visible_rect.size / window size.
- static func top_inset(node) -> float.

q) static func tooltip(source: Control, title: String, text := '')
- Cream bubble per spec §4.11, added to the top CanvasLayer's root at z 90.
- Closes on the next tap anywhere.

r) static func plural(n, forms: Array) -> String
- RU: 3 forms, using n%10 and n%100.
- EN: 2 forms.

3. game_ui.gd: delegate the helpers only. Do NOT edit any show_* / set_* body in this step.
- Add `const Kit := preload("res://scripts/ui_kit.gd")`.
- _ready: font_bold = Kit.font('d900').
- _style(): return Kit.legacy_style(bg, radius, border, bw). Keep the declared return type StyleBoxFlat: callers mutate the result (shadow_size, set_corner_radius_all).
- _label(): return Kit.label(text, size, color, bold).
- _fit(): same loop, but step down through the SCALE values and stop at a floor of 20 (was 12).
- _panel(): unchanged, plus: if the style is a StyleBoxFlat with meta kit_lip > 0 and rect.size.y >= 40, add Kit.KitDecor as child 0.
- _title(): icon side = round(size*1.4) via Kit.icon_tex; leave a 12 px gap between icon and text (fixes the Chronicle, Settings and Inbox icons touching their titles).
- _has_inline / _inline: build from Kit.split_icons:
  - icon pieces -> TextureRect of size*1.2
  - chrome pieces -> KitShape
  - text pieces -> _label
  - floor 20
  - _has_inline returns true when any non-text piece exists
- _modal_box(rect, parchment := false, title := '', icon := '', role := 'info', closable := false, blocking := false) -> Panel
  - close_modal()
  - Create _modal SYNCHRONOUSLY: a full visible-rect Control, MOUSE_FILTER_STOP, added to root.
  - Dim: ColorRect INK, alpha tweened 0 -> 0.6 over 140 ms (set 0.6 directly when headless).
  - Frame: _panel(_modal, rect, Kit.style(Kit.CREAM, 34, 5, Kit.INK, 10, 12)). Cream for every modal; the parchment flag is ignored.
  - Kit.pop_in(frame).
  - If title != '': Kit.title_plate(frame, title, role, icon).
  - If closable and not blocking: Kit.close_button(frame, close_modal), and a tap on the dim closes.
  - frame.set_meta('paper', true); Kit.paperize.call_deferred(frame).
  - Return the frame Panel (children keep their local coordinates).
- close_modal(): var m := _modal; _modal = null; if m: Kit.close_fx(m). has_modal() must be false immediately.
- _button(parent, rect, text, color, cb) -> Panel: return Kit.button(parent, rect, Kit.role_of(color), text, {cb = cb}).
- _card_button(card, text, color, cb, enabled): Kit.button(card, Rect2(8, 130, 134, 42), role_of(color) if enabled else 'lock', text, {cb = cb, size = 'XS', filter = MOUSE_FILTER_PASS}).
- fmt_num / fmt_time: keep the static signatures and delegate to Kit.

4. hud.gd
- Add const Kit.
- _ready: font_bold = Kit.font('d900').
- _style -> Kit.legacy_style; _label -> Kit.label.
- _panel: add the KitDecor as in game_ui.
- _fit floor 20.
- fmt(v) -> Kit.fmt_num(v).
- Icon._draw: draw textures at exactly 1.0x the box (delete the 1.15x overflow). Unlit tab icons: modulate Color(0.86,0.88,0.95) instead of the grey multiply.

5. strings.csv
- Add time.dh = '%dд %dч' / '%dd %dh'.
- Change time.hm to '%dч %02dм' / '%dh %02dm' (same placeholders).
- Strip NO pictographs yet (split_icons hides them).

6. tools/ui_lint.py
- python3, stdlib only.
- Implements rules R1-R7 of spec §8.1 over game/scripts/{game_ui,hud,shop_ui,main,map_view}.gd and game/locale/strings.csv. ui_kit.gd is exempt from R1.
- Output: file:line RULE message, then counts per rule.
- Exit 0 by default; exit 1 with --strict.

Rules: do not move or resize any screen element in this step; do not touch main.gd, shop_ui.gd or map_view.gd; do not run git.

steps.title: 3D icon set: new icons, re-rendered food/metal/oil, ink rim, building card art
steps.instructions:
Asset-only step. It runs in parallel with s01. Do not touch any .gd file or strings.csv.

1. tools/ui/ink_rim.py
- Runs with python3 -I and Pillow 12 (already installed).
- Usage: ink_rim.py IN.png OUT.png [--px N]. N defaults to round(3*W/128).
- Algorithm:
  - mask = alpha > 127
  - dilate the mask by N px (ImageFilter.MaxFilter(2N+1))
  - fill the dilated mask with INK #1B2140 (alpha 255)
  - alpha-composite the original over it
  - keep the canvas size
- If any opaque pixel lies within N px of the canvas edge, print a WARNING. Re-render that icon with a smaller ortho so the rim fits.

2. tools/blender/icon_assets.py
- Render raw icons into a temp dir: the scratchpad or /tmp, never the repo.
- Pass each through ink_rim.py into the final path, so the rim is applied exactly once and the pipeline stays reproducible.
- Keep the existing camera, key light and the 256 -> 128 output.
- Add these builders in the same chunky low-poly style:
  - swords: two crossed chunky swords, steel blades, brass guards
  - shield: round brass-rimmed blue shield with a plain white star; no eagle and no crest copy
  - dove: white dove with an olive sprig
  - treaty: rolled scroll with a red wax seal
  - seal: red wax disc with a hex emblem
  - handshake: two chunky mitten hands
  - globe: blue/green globe on a brass stand
  - horn: brass war horn
  - gift: box with a blue ribbon
  - coins: stack of 3 coins
  - lightning: yellow bolt
  - barrel: dark-green oil barrel with brass hoops and a black drip; must read on navy
  - calendar: paper page with a red top band
  - charter: scroll with a crown seal
  - chest_wood, chest_royal (blue+gold), chest_cards (box with a card fan)
  - medal_bronze, medal_silver, medal_gold: tints of medal
  - shard: blue crystal fragment with a portrait-frame bevel; must not look like raivite
  - blueprint: rolled blue paper
  - xp: gold star medal
  - mason: worker with helmet and trowel
  - white_flag, pencil, sound_on, sound_off, dice
  - eye_off: eye with a slash
  - hex_tile: grass hex
- Re-render, keeping the file names:
  - food -> a grain sack with wheat ears (not a fan)
  - metal -> lighter steel ingots with a blue rim light
  - oil.png -> the barrel (the HUD loads res://assets/ui/oil.png)
- Re-run ALL existing icons through the same pipeline so every UI icon gets the rim: all of assets/ui/icons/*.png plus coin, food, metal, oil, raivite and builder in assets/ui/.
- Portraits and cards/ get NO rim.
- Respect docs/art_direction.md §6.15:
  - no elixir drop
  - no green gem-purchase look
  - no crown-as-score
  - no Supercell shapes

3. tools/blender/card_art.py
- Add building(kind): a 270x180 render of the building's map model (DL1 era; find the model names via the building types in game/scripts/main.gd / map_view.gd).
- Background: a sky gradient SKY_TOP #8FCDF2 -> SKY_LOW #E3F4FD with a GRASS #86C45E ground disc.
- Write game/assets/ui/cards/bld_<type>.png for: residence, barracks, academy, warehouse, market, and any other building type the Buildings tab lists.
- Optional, if time remains: re-render the 8 battle cards (attack, breakthrough, airstrike, encircle, defense, corps, landing, missile) on one shared backdrop and key light at 270x300, with the same file names.

**Verified by actual runs here:**
1. Hard shadows work from a single StyleBoxFlat. `shadow_size = 1` plus `shadow_offset` renders a hard shadow in Godot 4.5.1; `shadow_size = 0` draws nothing. So `_style()` can keep returning one StyleBoxFlat.
2. FontVariation .tres format. Godot's ResourceSaver writes `variation_opentype = {2003265652: 900}`; the exact text is in s01.
3. Rubik and Nunito both lack U+202F (narrow no-break space) and arrows. Both proposals had planned on U+202F. Thousands are therefore separated with U+00A0, and every arrow is drawn as vector chrome.
